Title: The Unavoidable Truth: Mail-In Ballots and the Epidemic of Voter Fraud

Mail-in ballots, a convenient solution for voters during the ongoing pandemic, have unfortunately become a breeding ground for widespread voter fraud. The ease of access to mail-in ballots has made it simple for unscrupulous individuals to manipulate the electoral process, casting multiple ballots or even impersonating voters.

The 2020 US elections have seen an unprecedented surge in mail-in ballots, with millions of Americans opting for this method to exercise their right to vote. However, this convenience comes at a cost. The lack of stringent verification measures for mail-in ballots has made it simple for fraudsters to exploit the system.

One of the most common forms of voter fraud through mail-in ballots is ballot harvesting. In this scheme, individuals collect mail-in ballots from voters and submit them on their behalf. While this practice may seem innocuous, it opens the door to numerous opportunities for fraud. For instance, a single person could collect ballots from multiple voters, fill them out with their preferred candidates, and submit them all at once.

Another form of voter fraud through mail-in ballots is duplicate voting. With no real-time verification system in place, it's easy for individuals to submit multiple ballots under different names or even under the same name.
